nom: Exfoliating Himalayan Salt Scrub with Collagen & Stem Cells

segments.oily: The one reviewer who describes her skin as oily uses the scrub nightly on her face and reports it lifts dirt without stripping or drying her skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including dryness linked to pregnancy, postpartum, cold weather, or aging, consistently report the scrub left skin noticeably softer and more hydrated, sometimes replacing the need for a separate moisturizer.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin most often report the scrub left their skin soft and calm without irritation, including cases of fragrance allergy and acne-prone skin clearing up; a minority instead report rashes, breakouts, or irritation, and one non-sensitive reviewer describes a severe reaction with red welts.
segments.mature: The two reviewers who mention their age describe using the scrub on long-standing rough, bumpy skin from aging; one reports it became noticeably smoother, while the other had a severe reaction with red welts on the chest, neck, and hands.

concerns.dehydration: This is the dominant, near-universal report: reviewers with dry skin, including cases linked to postpartum, pregnancy, or cold-weather dryness, describe skin left noticeably softer and more hydrated after use, often without needing a separate moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation, including some who are sensitive to fragrance; however, a few describe the opposite — new red marks, welts, or a reaction resembling a chemical burn on the chest, neck, or hands after use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including ones who call their skin sensitive or acne-prone, report the scrub cleared hormonal, pregnancy-related, or back and chest acne and reduced redness around blemishes; one reviewer instead reports new breakouts and red marks appearing after use.

aspects.libelle: Jar frequently arrives underfilled or half-empty
Seal often leaks or arrives already broken
Dry, hard texture that needs water to soften
Can sting on fresh cuts, razor nicks or broken skin
Light, pleasant scent, though some find it faint
Considered expensive for the container size

extraits.titre: May cause Rash or breakouts if you have sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I had high hopes for this product and since it was on sale at the time of buying I figured it would be a no brainer. After reading up on reviews it seemed to be a good choice for a body scrub. I’ll break this down into three parts. First thing, The scent is very underwhelming. I like my body wash or body scrub to smell good and this didn’t really have a scent at all. Second, The moisturizing part was decent. Not bad but not great either. It goes on rough and feels like you’re washing your body with sand. And your skin comes out soft. Not bad. You also have to use a lot if you are wanting to cover your whole body. Even being sparing I used multiple scoops during the one time I used this. Third, The scrub has likely caused my skin to break out where I applied it left new red marks a few days later. Not sure if it’s just my skin’s sensitivity but It didn’t occur until after the fact that I used this body scrub. In conclusion, no great scent, feels like rubbing your skin with sand, and can cause rash or breakouts if you have sensitive skin like myself.

I purchased this product based on reviews. As I am older I thought it might help with age spots on my hands. I used the product for a couple of weeks and it did feel good applying and I had no problems with my arms or legs. However, my chest and neck area was covered with red welts. My hand actually looked like it had a chemical burn. I haven't been using it or at least two weeks and have been moisturizing every day. I finally started using cortisone and that seems to help. However, as you can see from the picture the mark on my hand is still there. I saw this recommended for the face. I would highly advise against this. I will add that I typically do not have particularly sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Non-irritating & leaves skin exfoliated, soft, supple, clean, & smelling great!
extraits.texte: I love this Himalayan salt scrub! I have used several different brands of salt, sugar, and coffee scrubS in the past, and immediately noticed a positive difference with this one. Upon opening the well-packaged tub, this scrub looked finer, smoother, and creamier than most other brands I have used thus far. After reading the ingredients, I learned this is because, in addition to the salt, there is collagen and other skin boosting ingredients! Also, this brand is much finer than most salt scrubs I have used, which tend to be more corse and jagged. I did not have any irritation with this brand when used before shaving, but due to the salty nature, I don’t recommend use after shaving (salt irritates fresh tiny nicks), and I have VERY sensitive skin. After using this scrub in the shower, my skin felt so soft and smooth that I didn't even need to use lotion after! With my dry, sensitive skin, I ALWAYS need to moisturize after a shower, but this scrub moisturized and exfoliated all in one! (Although, note the directions still say to moisturize after use). I'd also like to comment on the please thank smell of this scrub. I absolutely love it! Sweet and fresh and not overbearing and artificial at all. Overall, this is an excellent product. I highly recommend it. * I am committed to providing completely honest and unbiased reviews. This and all of my reviews contain only my personal, sincere opinions. Please let me know if you found this review helpful, and feel free to comment if not

extraits.titre: Wonderful Facial Scrub, Solid Body Exfoliator
extraits.texte: I bought this product originally to use before applying my self tanner. After reading tons of reviews, it seemed like a really great option for exfoliating my sensitive/ acne prone skin. The first time I tried it, I applied all over my body while in the bath. It seemed to do a good job. My skin felt hydrated, but not greasy. I wish the smell was a little more noticeable....but over all a solid product for exfoliating your body. After using it a few times on my body, I decided to try it on my face. Now, this is where this product really shined for me. I have very sensitive acne prone skin. I have been struggling with hormonal acne on my jawline for the majority of my adult life. For about the past month or so I have been using this on my face every time I shower and my acne is gone! In the instance of using it on my face, I am appreciative of the light scent and gentle exfoliation. I love this product to use on my face and will definitely repurchase for that purpose.

extraits.titre: Certified Natural Product for Oily Skin
extraits.texte: Love this natural product. Proven natural because the ingredients listed on label are legit and pronounceable. I do not put chemicals and crazy stuff on my skin. I use to exfoliate my oily a$$ face every night before bed, so this salt scrub is perfect for lifting dirt. There are oils in it so my face does not feel stripped or dry, but lightly soft. The scent is nice, a bit strong, though not unpleasant. I would not recommend for sensitive or dry skin, because this is a raw product and will likely irritate you. It can get a bit messy, I usually have to wipe multiple times. Overall, worth it. There is even a little coupon that says my next one is free (it's a big jar though won't be running out anytime soon)!! [:

extraits.titre: Best scrub I've tried; totally worth the price!
extraits.texte: Was skeptical to purchase because of the price, but I took a chance after reading the reviews. I'm so glad that I did! Noticed an IMMEDIATE difference in my skin after the FIRST use. Unlike drugstore scrubs I used before, this scrub REALLY exfoliates and moisturizes my super dry skin. I was soo impressed I recommended it to my friends in a Facebook post.
